<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a template that matches the Doebner modification forward reaction: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated carboxylic acid (cinnamic acid). The forward reaction forms an alkene and a carboxylic acid, and breaks a C‑C bond (between carbonyl carbon and α‑carbon) and a C‑O bond (decarboxylation). Use the product cinnamic acid SMILES as the target molecule and filter for templates that break a carboxylic acid and form an alkene.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic_acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
